answer: island anchors a cedar only against a fresh hardware root: one exclusive host per cedar, proven by a TPM quote. Each host must post ocean as a bond equal to the number of hosts already registered in island, read and charged atomically at anchor, burned if that host signs a second cedar. A thousand-clone flood needs a thousand exclusive hosts and pays a rising ocean bond on each; one host cannot be split and bulk virtual hosts fail the quote. The bill is ocean locked per host at its registration rank, and it breaks if hosts are virtualized without exclusive TPM or bonds transfer.
